records.required_statement: Two injections f,g from a finite type to one ambient type extend to a permutation sigma satisfying sigma(f a)=g a.
records.notation_and_application: The finite source is Fin e, ambient is Fin(e+q), f is Fin.castAdd q, and g is the selected column injection. This yields the required coordinate permutation.

records.required_statement: A continuous equivalence from a compact source to a Hausdorff target is a homeomorphism.
records.notation_and_application: The equivalence is Equiv.ofBijective applied to actual polynomial evaluation restricted to residue balls. The input ball is compact and output inherits Hausdorffness from a finite product of p-adic integers.

records.required_statement: For a prime p, the p-adic integers are a compact topological space.
records.notation_and_application: Finite products are compact. The internal closed-residue-ball proof then gives compact input balls; their continuous images are compact and hence closed in the Hausdorff codomain.

records.notation_and_application: Coordinatewise divisibility defines exactly a closed metric residue ball and bounds the distance of canonical integer truncations.
